6226da3fa894bacb889c4c7c42bd01bc58336b81kevinscherncascadeKEVINS@ILLUMENATE.LIGHTINGkevinscherncascadeKEVINS@ILLUMENATE.LIGHTING17876149512026-08-24T16:42:31-07:00e0560bb2c33ed62dc22ec69502b99c493c0b8b65Fix schedule → Sales Order conversion and Section / Room field alignmentCollapse the two divergent schedule → transaction converters into one and
fix the field-mapping bugs that broke section grouping on print formats.

Converter
- create_sales_order now delegates to append_quote_lines, the single
  converter also used by the desk "Get Items From → Fixture Schedule"
  flow. This fixes "No ilLumenate configured lines found in this
  schedule" for ACCESSORY-only schedules: accessories are stored with
  manufacturer_type == "ACCESSORY" but the portal badges them as
  ilLumenate, and the old create_sales_order filter excluded them.
- Add the missing LED Sheet branch. Sheet rows use line.qty (the bundle
  count) — never sheets_needed, which double-counts pricing.
- READY *and* QUOTED schedules can now convert; the portal button
  already offered both.
- Skipped lines (OTHER, unconfigured) are reported instead of silently
  dropped, and surfaced in the portal and desk messages.
- The resolved configured Item is now persisted onto the schedule line
  instead of being written to an unsaved in-memory row.

Quantities
- create_kit_so_lines and create_tape_neon_so_lines take a
  qty_multiplier; append_quote_lines passes line.qty. A schedule line
  for 5 kits now produces 5 kits' worth of components.
- The portal's kit stock panel reported per-kit requirements regardless
  of line.qty, so it would have shown "in stock" for a 3-kit line that
  the Sales Order cannot fulfil. It now scales the required quantities
  by the line's kit count, keeping the panel and the order in agreement.

Fields
- Print formats read ill_section_label (app-owned) instead of
  custom_ill_section_label, the stray Customize-Form twin.
- New patch consolidate_section_label_field migrates any data from the
  stray field, deletes it, and creates the fields below.
- ill_section_label added to Delivery Note Item, Sales Invoice Item and
  Purchase Order Item so get_mapped_doc carries it down the chain.
- New ill_fixture_type (from line.line_id) on Quotation Item, Sales
  Order Item, Delivery Note Item and Sales Invoice Item.
- New traceability fields: ill_fixture_schedule on the Quotation and
  Sales Order headers, ill_schedule_line_id on their item rows.

Client scripts
- The section label no longer clobbers the description of real item
  rows — only genuine separator rows (no item, no qty) borrow it.
- "Add Section / Room" created a zero-qty, item-less row that ERPNext
  rejects on save. Replaced with "Set Section / Room", which tags the
  selected (or untagged) item rows.

Tests
- Regression coverage for accessory-only, mixed, LED Sheet, QUOTED-status
  and OTHER-only conversions; qty multipliers; kit stock scaling; and
  section / fixture-type mapping from Quotation to Sales Order.
